idea: Little science wonder – ICE MELTS in the warm sun (BACKYARD, Ava in HOME outfit): a little yellow rubber duck is frozen inside a big clear ice block on a white plate right beside Baby Ava's face ('Oh no! My duck is in the ice!'); she touches it with one fingertip ('Ice is cold! Cold, cold, cold!'); 'Warm sun, shine, shine, shine!'; chorus 'Drip, drip, drip! The ice melts!' – the ice drips and gets smaller; copy-me 'Melt with me! Down, down, down!' (she wiggles lower and lower); payoff 'Hooray! My duck is free!' (duck floats in the water on the plate); she asks the viewer 'What melts the ice? Hmm?' (pause) – 'The sun! The warm sun! Yay!'; lesson 'Ice melts into water!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now with the duck free in the water, bye-bye wave.
title: Oh No! My Duck Is in the Ice! 🧊 Melting Ice | Science for Toddlers with Baby Ava | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Ava's little yellow rubber duck is stuck inside a big block of ice! The ice is cold, cold, cold… so how can the duck get out? Watch the warm sun do its magic – drip, drip, drip – and shout the answer with Ava!

🎬 What happens in this video:
🧊 "Oh no! My duck is in the ice!"
❄️ Ava touches the ice – it's cold, cold, cold!
☀️ The warm sun shines… drip, drip, drip – the ice melts!
💃 Melt with me – wiggle down, down, down!
🦆 Hooray! The duck is free in the water!
🤔 "What melts the ice?" – shout the answer: the warm sun!
👋 Ice melts into water! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: ice is cold • the warm sun melts ice • ice turns into water • ice • cold • melt • sun • water

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun little science sing-along for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Ava finds her rubber duck frozen in an ice block in the sunny backyard, feels how cold the ice is, and watches the warm sun melt the ice into water until her duck is free.
